title: Netflix Unveils Poster and Release Date for 'On Behalf of My Son,' Gabriel Martins’ New Film
summary: Netflix today unveils the poster and release date for On Behalf of My Son, which will arrive in select theaters on November 5 and on Netflix on November 20, launching simultaneously in more than 190 countries
body_markdown:
São Paulo, August 27, 2026 -


Four years after


Mars One,


Gabriel Martins returns to the screen with his new feature film. Netflix today unveils the poster and release date for


On Behalf of My Son


, which will arrive in select theaters on November 5 and on Netflix on November 20, launching simultaneously in more than 190 countries. The only Brazilian film selected for the 51st edition of the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), taking place in September, the feature will have its international premiere in the Platform section, a competitive program dedicated to standout works of contemporary cinema. The winner of the section qualifies directly for consideration for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film, underscoring the significance of the selection for the film’s international trajectory.


On Behalf of My Son


is also part of the Official Selection of the 74th San Sebastián International Film Festival in Spain, where it will compete for the Golden Shell, the festival’s top prize. In addition, the film will also be screened at the AFI Latin America Film Festival and the Cinelatino Minneapolis Film Festival before its national premiere in the competitive program of the 28th edition of the Rio Film Festival, taking place from October 1 to 11. At the heart of the story, Rejane Faria delivers a powerful and nuanced performance as Vicentina, guiding audiences through the complexity of a mother who, following her son's death, embarks on a journey to confront the consequences of the tragedy and come to terms with her own grief. The performance reaffirms the strength of the actress, who previously stood out in


Mars One


, and gives the film its emotional core. Produced by Filmes de Plástico,


On Behalf of My Son


stars Rejane Faria, alongside Flávio Bauraqui, Giovanna Heliodoro, Giovanni Venturini, Grace Passô, Karine Teles, Maíra Azevedo, Renato Novaes and Thalma de Freitas. Gabriel Martins serves as director and is also responsible for the screenplay and original story.


On Behalf of My Son


opens in select theaters on November 5 and on Netflix on November 20.


About


On Behalf of My Son


Synopsis:


On a sunny morning in Belo Horizonte, a crowded bus makes its way toward the city center. As it crosses a viaduct, the vehicle suddenly swerves, veers off the road and plunges onto the avenue below. One passenger is critically injured, while everyone else — including Wesley, the driver — dies. The tragedy dominates television news and newspaper headlines across the country. Security cameras on the bus and along the road capture the moment of the accident, and after the footage is analyzed, speculation begins to circulate that the driver may have acted intentionally. Vicentina, a 75-year-old retired teacher and Wesley’s mother, is devastated by the tragedy and unsure of how to move forward. She decides to seek out the families of the victims and apologize. The path ahead proves difficult, and the answers Vicentina is searching for are not always the ones she finds.

About Netflix:


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About Filmes de Plástico


Founded in 2009 by André Novais Oliveira, Gabriel Martins, Maurilio Martins, and Thiago Macêdo Correia, FILMES DE PLÁSTICO is one of Brazil's leading film production companies, recognized for films that portray Black and working-class communities with honesty and dignity. Its productions have been screened and awarded at major international festivals — such as Cannes, Berlin, Sundance, Locarno, and Rotterdam — and, in 2023, the company represented Brazil as the official submission for the 95th Academy Awards® with the film


Mars One


(


Marte Um


). In addition to developing its own projects locally, the production company also works to train and foster new talent within its community.
